definitions.definition: First rule that matches, in this order: unswept (no completed sweep in catalogs/saturation/ledger.json covers the layer); no-winner (the verdict is pending_lanes or no_selection, or there are no winners); reopened (a completed sweep covering the layer is dated after the verdict's checked_at, component_matrix layer_state recorded_reopened); converged (layer_state confirmed_current and the matrix converged count equals its in_use count, which is above 0); current (otherwise). For an explicit FINAL claim, a later sweep reopens only with a named, retained change reference; a date-only matrix reopening does not revoke FINAL.

The verdict's checked_at plus policy.review_days, for a recorded or no_selection verdict; null for pending lanes and planned layers. It is a date, never a staleness: --check --today D flags a layer when D is past it.

The verdict pin parsed in one of the forms <version>, <commit>, <version> @ <commit> and <version>; source <commit> (a 40-hex commit); otherwise pin_parse is unpinned (the text 'unpinned') or unparsed. Free text is flagged, never guessed.

One entry per component a run-pin source pins, keyed by normalized repository (or by id without one). Precedence: the allowlisted lockfile blueprints/us-equities/runtime-2604/trading-2604-runtime/uv.lock (its root package's direct requirements, with exact version/artifact source identities from catalogs/landscape/lockfile-source-identities.json), adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json, adoption/pins-macos-arm64.json tools[].version, manifests/stack.json version/source_pin and catalogs/us-equities/runtime-target.json#/engine; the first source is the run pin and every other source whose parsed pin differs is listed under conflicts. Fields absent from that first source are compared between lower sources too. platforms lists the adoption pin files that install the same pin.

When the chosen source supplies a nonempty noncommit source pin, source_pin retains its original text. source_pin_kind is sha256 for a 64-hex artifact digest and tag for other retained values. A 40-hex Git source pin is merged into pin_parsed.commit instead. No missing source pin is invented.

The pointer to the record supplying the complete run pin. For an exact lock-source supplement match, this points into catalogs/landscape/lockfile-source-identities.json bindings; that binding's source points back to the unchanged lock entry whose version and complete artifact hash set were matched. The lock itself records no Git commit.

The runs[] id whose repository is the winner's (a run without a repository joins only by the same id), or null with run_reason held (the layer's current_adoption_status is held), external (scripts/final_stack.py EXTERNAL_RUN_PINS), unpinned (the verdict pin is 'unpinned') or unresolved.

same when the verdict and run pins share a parsed field (version with version, commit with commit) and every shared field matches (scripts/host_receipts.py pin_matches); differs when one does not; unknown when they share none, including an unpinned or unparsed pin; null without a run.

Cumulative distinct normalized repositories over the completed sweeps (stopped sweeps excluded). found: ledger proposed plus the landscape candidates, alternatives and winners; refuted: the latest refutation without a later survival or missing-vote-only re-proposal; surviving: an unresolved survival or missing-vote proposal dated after the verdict; trialled: landscape rows with measured_comparison evidence or a measured_tradeoff disposition; adopted: winners with a run pin.

The unresolved repositories of the funnel, with their latest survival or the missing-vote-only sweep and date that opened or reopened them. For explicit FINAL claims, replay the cumulative set without a verdict-date filter: only retained substantive refutation or an explicit retained verdict disposition settles a survivor, never age or omission.
by_repository (normalized) and by_component_id (winners) map to every layer and role (winner, alternate, survivor, candidate) that names them.
